clue.text: Redesigned flats suit musicians

clue.text: Trophy given? There's room for improvement in hospital

definitions.text: There's room for improvement in hospital

blocks.note: first meaning: a prize presented

blocks.clueFragment: There's room for improvement in hospital

clue.text: A number of exercises one left out? Climbers depend on them

clue.text: Fleecing a woman over a piece of jewelry

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Shearing removes the fleece from a sheep, so fleecing in its literal sense is shearing.

clue.text: Poles at church showing pluck

blocks.note: S and N are the south and north poles
taken as written

clue.text: Bankruptcy — little credit remains

explanation.surface: A business goes bust and has only a scrap of credit left.

clue.text: Food said to raise a smile

clue.text: Give credit for quality

second meaning: the noun, a characteristic or feature

clue.text: Rook and duck caught by another bird - or another

explanation.definitionFit: A heron is a long-legged wading bird, so it is a further bird beyond those already named.
